
## Before you start

- **This is a beta. Keep backups of your music.** Audio Sorter moves files and writes tags
  in place (losslessly, with verified atomic writes), and bar edits are saved as new files
  beside the originals, but test it on copies first.
- Supported: MP3, WAV and AIFF; constant-tempo 4/4 grids; Rekordbox 7 via rekordbox XML.
- Settings live in `~/Library/Application Support/Audio Sorter/`. Open **Settings…**
  (⌘,) first to choose your source folder and destination folders.
- Nothing is uploaded: the app works entirely on your Mac.

Found a bug or have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/samb0t/AudioSorter/issues/new/choose).
